name: Anna Katell
source:
Don't let the appearance fool you. People of the Cattus species are too small.
Kattel is a slave, but she is cheerful and trusts people a lot, albeit a bit skittish. Her liking for her scars earns her the nickname "weird girl".

[From [url=https://estudios-luna.itch.io/monmusu-fantasy-series-la-chica-en-el-bosque-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
